summary: The Abyssal Trench is the deepest and most dangerous region of the Plane of Water. Crushing pressure, eternal darkness, and ancient abyssal entities define this hostile realm.
history: The trench formed when primordial currents carved a massive fissure into the elemental seabed.
Bioluminescent organisms evolved to survive the crushing depths.
Abyssal titans emerged from the trench core, embodying ancient elemental power.
The Abyssal Colossus became the apex guardian of the trench’s deepest pit.
